Service accounts, managed service accounts (gMSA and dMSA), Microsoft Entra workload identities (applications, service principals and managed identities) and AI agent identities: finding every one, giving it owners and a sponsor, deciding its target, setting its credential rules, cutting its privilege, migrating it and keeping the evidence.

Work down the page: understand the design, plan it, build it, learn it, watch it, download it, and keep the evidence. [All topics](index.md) lists the others.
